name: The Scree Mother
place: stands like a cairn beside the high pass and wakes when people stop to rest
_doc: Stream E (M2). A walking heap of loose rock. It rains stones that STAY as rocks, then sings a rumble you dodge by putting a fallen rock between you and it (line of sight). At half health it shakes itself and the scree slides down in long lines.

party.solo: Solo works if you hide well; the rumble hurts if you are caught in the open.
party.small: Easy with one person keeping stones near the group.
party.full: Trivial; spread out so stones fall where you want cover.
party.m5: M5 adds health per extra player and one more copy of the spread/scatter shapes for parties of 4-5; mechanics stay the same.

pull: Pebbles rattle uphill toward you. That is not how pebbles work.
say.death: The Scree Mother slumps into an ordinary heap of stones.
say.reset: The stones settle back into a cairn.

stonefall.name: Stonefall
stonefall.say: Stones come loose from the slope!

rumble.name: Deep Rumble
rumble.say: The Scree Mother groans from deep inside — put a fallen stone between you!

phases.name: Landslide
phases.say: The whole heap shudders and slides!
